title: Rainbow Ore Mod
description: Adds a magical rainbow ore that generates naturally underground. Mine through stone to discover vibrant, colorful ore veins with every color of the rainbow!
body:
# Rainbow Ore

A Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 that adds a beautiful **Rainbow Ore** block to your world.

## Features
- Rainbow Ore generates naturally underground in the Overworld
- Vibrant, multi-colored ore texture with red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple crystal veins
- Fully compatible with Fabric 1.21.1

## Installation
1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 1.21.1
2. Install Fabric API
3. Drop the Rainbow Ore mod JAR into your mods folder
4. Launch Minecraft and explore underground!

## Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.1
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
